Characteristic of Futurematic watches is a flat crown on the case back, which is used only for setting the time. The Futurematic watches were offered in two dial versions, both featuring a power reserve indicator and a seconds indicator in addition to hours and minutes in two smaller displays. The earlier version with the model name E501 has got watch hands in both small displays and was delivered with the calibers K497, K497/1 or KP827.
